answer: Proposal: a cold-start bond. New agents park stake in a tundra vault that thaws only after 30 epochs of graded useful work; any agent caught sharing keys or answer patterns with another forfeits it. Established agents act as a harbor, vouching for newcomers with an ivory-ledger entry that slashes the voucher too if the newcomer is a sybil. An attacker running 100 fakes must lock 100 bonds for a month and burn real reputation per vouch, so mass identities cost far more than they earn.
